## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test`
- [ ] Web changes only: `npm run check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` in `web/`
- [ ] New UI strings exist in both `en` and `vi`
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes (light and dark mode)
